# Secure Environment Manager — Full Reference

> Complete API reference, architecture, and integration guide for Secure Environment Manager (SEM).
> Self-hosted, AES-256 encrypted secrets management for modern development teams.

## Architecture

```
Frontend (Next.js 15, port 3000)
  └── API Client (fetch-based, JWT auth)
        └── Flask REST API (port 8070)
              └── Fernet encryption layer
                    └── File storage: data/<namespace>/<environment>.enc
```

### Key design decisions

- **File-based storage**: each namespace/environment is one `.enc` file on disk; no database dependency
- **Encryption**: Python `cryptography` library, Fernet (AES-128-CBC + HMAC-SHA256 by default; upgrade path to AES-256 available)
- **Stateless API**: JWT tokens carry identity; server validates signature, no session state
- **Append-only audit**: audit log grows monotonically; integrity verified on read

## Authentication Reference

### Dashboard password login
```http
POST /api/v1/auth/validate-password
Content-Type: application/json

{ "password": "your-dashboard-password" }
```
Returns: `{ "valid": true }` — client then uses the raw password as a Bearer token.

### User login (JWT)
```http
POST /api/v1/auth/login
Content-Type: application/json

{ "username": "alice", "password": "secret123", "namespace": "myapp", "environment": "production" }
```
Returns:
```json
{
  "access_token": "<jwt>",
  "refresh_token": "<jwt>",
  "token_type": "bearer",
  "expires_in": 900,
  "must_change_password": false,
  "username": "alice",
  "scopes": ["read", "write"]
}
```

### Refresh access token
```http
POST /api/v1/auth/refresh
Content-Type: application/json

{ "refresh_token": "<refresh_jwt>" }
```

### API key login
```http
POST /api/v1/auth/login
Content-Type: application/json

{ "api_key": "sem_xxxx...", "namespace": "myapp", "environment": "production" }
```

## Secrets API

### Read all secrets
```http
GET /api/v1/secrets/{namespace}/{environment}
Authorization: Bearer <token>
```
Response:
```json
{
  "namespace": "myapp",
  "environment": "production",
  "secrets": {
    "DATABASE_URL": "postgres://...",
    "REDIS_URL": "redis://..."
  },
  "count": 2,
  "last_updated": "2025-01-15T10:30:00Z"
}
```

### Write secrets (merge)
```http
POST /api/v1/secrets/{namespace}/{environment}
Authorization: Bearer <token>
Content-Type: application/json

{ "DATABASE_URL": "postgres://new-host/db" }
```
Merges new keys into existing secrets. Existing keys not in the payload are unchanged.

### Bulk replace
```http
PUT /api/v1/secrets/{namespace}/{environment}
Authorization: Bearer <token>
Content-Type: application/json

{ "KEY1": "val1", "KEY2": "val2" }
```
Replaces ALL secrets atomically. Previous values are lost (use history to recover).

### Delete a secret key
```http
DELETE /api/v1/secrets/{namespace}/{environment}/{key}
Authorization: Bearer <token>
```

### Export as .env
```http
GET /api/v1/secrets/{namespace}/{environment}/export
Authorization: Bearer <token>
Accept: text/plain
```
Returns a `.env`-formatted file:
```
DATABASE_URL=postgres://...
REDIS_URL=redis://...
```

## Version History API

### List snapshots
```http
GET /api/v1/history/{namespace}/{environment}
Authorization: Bearer <token>
```

### Get a snapshot
```http
GET /api/v1/history/{namespace}/{environment}/{snapshot_id}
Authorization: Bearer <token>
```

### Restore a snapshot
```http
POST /api/v1/history/{namespace}/{environment}/{snapshot_id}/restore
Authorization: Bearer <token>
```

## Audit Log API

### Get audit log
```http
GET /api/v1/audit/{namespace}/{environment}
Authorization: Bearer <token>
```
Optional query params: `?limit=50&offset=0&action=set`

Response:
```json
{
  "entries": [
    {
      "id": "uuid",
      "timestamp": "2025-01-15T10:30:00Z",
      "action": "set",
      "resource": "DATABASE_URL",
      "namespace": "myapp",
      "environment": "production",
      "actor": "alice",
      "ip": "127.0.0.1"
    }
  ],
  "total": 42
}
```

## API Keys API

### List keys for a namespace
```http
GET /api/v1/keys/{namespace}
Authorization: Bearer <master-token-or-dashboard-password>
```

### Create a key
```http
POST /api/v1/keys/{namespace}
Authorization: Bearer <master-token-or-dashboard-password>
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "description": "GitHub Actions CI",
  "validity_days": 90,
  "namespaces": ["myapp", "shared"],
  "custom_key": "my-custom-key-value-here"
}
```
- `validity_days: 0` = no expiry
- `namespaces: []` = access to all namespaces
- `custom_key` is optional; auto-generated if omitted

Response includes the full key value only once — store it immediately.

### Revoke a key
```http
DELETE /api/v1/keys/{namespace}/{key_id}
Authorization: Bearer <master-token-or-dashboard-password>
```

## User Management API (admin only)

### List users
```http
GET /api/v1/users
Authorization: Bearer <master-token>
```

### Create user
```http
POST /api/v1/users
Authorization: Bearer <master-token>
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "username": "alice",
  "password": "temporary-password",
  "email": "alice@example.com",
  "scopes": ["read", "write"],
  "namespaces": ["myapp"]
}
```

### Change password (authenticated user)
```http
POST /api/v1/user/change-password
Authorization: Bearer <user-access-token>
Content-Type: application/json

{ "current_password": "old", "new_password": "new-secure-password" }
```

## Analytics API

### Get usage statistics
```http
GET /api/v1/meta/stats
Authorization: Bearer <token>
```

### Get activity analytics
```http
GET /api/v1/meta/analytics?days=7
Authorization: Bearer <token>
```

Response includes:
- `trends`: daily activity counts
- `distribution.namespaces`: secret counts per namespace

## Environment Comparison API

### Compare two environments
```http
GET /api/v1/compare/{namespace}/{env1}/{env2}
Authorization: Bearer <token>
```

Response:
```json
{
  "only_in_env1": ["KEY_A"],
  "only_in_env2": ["KEY_B"],
  "different_values": ["DATABASE_URL"],
  "identical": ["PORT", "NODE_ENV"]
}
```

## Template API

### List templates
```http
GET /api/v1/templates
Authorization: Bearer <token>
```

### Apply a template
```http
POST /api/v1/templates/{namespace}/{environment}/apply
Authorization: Bearer <token>
Content-Type: application/json

{ "template_id": "nodejs-basic" }
```

## Error Response Format

All errors follow this shape:
```json
{
  "error": "Human-readable description",
  "code": "MACHINE_READABLE_CODE",
  "status": 401
}
```

Common error codes:
- `AUTH_TOKEN_MISSING` — no Authorization header
- `AUTH_TOKEN_INVALID` — token expired or invalid
- `AUTH_NAMESPACE_FORBIDDEN` — token lacks access to this namespace
- `AUTH_MASTER_REQUIRED` — operation requires master token
- `STORAGE_NOT_FOUND` — namespace or environment doesn't exist
- `STORAGE_KEY_NOT_FOUND` — secret key doesn't exist
- `VALIDATION_KEY_INVALID` — secret key contains invalid characters
- `RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED` — too many requests (429)

## Environment Variables (Server Configuration)

The backend reads these environment variables on startup:

| Variable | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `ENCRYPTION_KEY` | Yes | Fernet key (base64); generate with `python generate_keys.py` |
| `DASHBOARD_PASSWORD` | Yes | Password for web UI admin login |
| `MASTER_TOKEN` | Recommended | Full-access API token for automation |
| `ADMIN_USERNAME` | No | Display name for admin user (default: "admin") |
| `ADMIN_EMAIL` | No | Admin email for notifications |
| `SMTP_HOST` | No | SMTP server for email notifications |
| `SMTP_PORT` | No | SMTP port (default: 587) |
| `SMTP_USER` | No | SMTP username |
| `SMTP_PASSWORD` | No | SMTP password |
| `JWT_SECRET` | No | JWT signing secret (auto-generated if omitted) |
| `PORT` | No | Backend port (default: 8070) |

## Integration Examples

### CI/CD (GitHub Actions)
```yaml
- name: Load secrets
  run: |
    curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer ${{ secrets.SEM_API_KEY }}" \
      https://sem.example.com/api/v1/secrets/myapp/production/export \
      >> $GITHUB_ENV
```

### Node.js SDK pattern
```js
const res = await fetch(`${SEM_URL}/api/v1/secrets/${namespace}/${environment}`, {
  headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${SEM_API_KEY}` },
});
const { secrets } = await res.json();
process.env = { ...process.env, ...secrets };
```

### Python pattern
```python
import requests, os

resp = requests.get(
    f"{os.environ['SEM_URL']}/api/v1/secrets/{namespace}/{environment}",
    headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ['SEM_API_KEY']}"},
)
secrets = resp.json()["secrets"]
os.environ.update(secrets)
```
